system.description:
[Trigger: Setup]: You gain a +5 bonus to your next damage roll. Treat this effect as a Combat Status that is removed after applying once. You also take [Weakness: 10]. Treat this effect as a Bad Status that lasts until the end of the round.

An ancient warrior's costume passed down in Ezzo. Dressed in bearskins, they were said to have gone mad in battle and defeated their enemies at the expense of themselves.

Mad Bear Fur [Core Material] (40G) + Hide Armor (130G) + [Magic Catalyst 3] (25G) x 3 + Crafting Cost (105G)
